synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — an intact, growing brand and clean balance sheet against a 97% FY26 EBITDA reset whose margin recovery management itself defers to 2027.

bull_points.claim: The de-rate is discrete and event-driven — two gap-downs on FY25 earnings + founder/executive-chair departure (Feb) and Q1 earnings + a butter wind-down restructuring (May), not a slow secular bleed.
bull_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bull_points.claim: The overshoot reading rests on a preserved franchise: revenue compounded from $74M (FY17) to $759M (FY25) with absolute EBITDA rising $-1M→$103M, so the collapse is a pricing-gap air-pocket rather than a demand-destruction of the brand.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: Management is actively narrowing the price gap and the mechanism is showing early volume response — a top-10 customer moved from ~35% to ~25% premium and volumes rose 18% after two weeks.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Distribution momentum is real and forward-visible — an at-least-50% TDP increase with a top-3 customer and a plan to add 20–30 TDPs (15–25%) over 2026, its best yearly TDP gain since IPO.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The existing consumer base held despite the price gap — units per retained household ran 2% above the prior-8-quarter average, so the velocity slowdown traces to new-household acquisition, not attrition.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet gives room to absorb the reset: net-debt/EBITDA 0.0x, interest coverage 99.4x, and an undrawn JPMorgan revolver due 2029 with no near-term maturity stated.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt $3M [Q1 Mar-29-2026] ÷ CIQ EBITDA $80M [LTM 12 months Mar-29-2026]

bull_points.claim: A peer discount exists on trailing multiples (name TEV/EBITDA 1.5x vs peer median 7.7x) alongside superior growth and lower leverage (rev growth 26% vs 2%, Debt/EBITDA 0.1 vs 3.4) — posing whether the gap is EARNED or RESIDUAL, though against a HETEROGENEOUS peer set that cannot be read as a clean benchmark.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: The near-floor trailing EV/EBITDA (1.5x, 8th percentile of own history) is NOT the real signal it appears to be — the forward NTM TEV/EBITDA is 89.3x because consensus FY26 EBITDA collapsed to ~$3.4M, so the optically cheap trailing multiple masks a business earning almost nothing next year.
The earnings reset is severe and definitional, not optical: FY26 consensus EBITDA was cut from $133.7M (6m ago) to $3.42M (−97%) and EBIT/EPS crossed into negative territory.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

bear_points.claim: The falling EBITDA margin (14% FY25 → 10% LTM, guided ~0% FY26) is corroborated by falling ABSOLUTE EBITDA ($103M FY25 → $79M LTM → ~$3M guided FY26) — this is not a case of a % declining while dollars rise; both are falling together.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: The company is burning cash — LTM levered FCF −$53.9M with the CFO−capex read at −$89.7M — so the balance-sheet cushion is being consumed while the reset plays out.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-29-2026]

bear_points.claim: The core demand problem is structural at current prices: the new-household share fell from >55% (2024–25) to 50% in Q1-26, evidence the brand cannot convert awareness into trial at prevailing price gaps.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: Broker revisions are uniformly and repeatedly downward across revenue, EBITDA and EPS with recommendations cut to Hold and consensus FY26 EPS now negative — the analyst community is marking the reset down, not fading it.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

bear_points.claim: The recovery depends on a cost-restructuring whose benefits management itself defers to 2027 and beyond (feed COGS, headcount, supply right-sizing), leaving 2026 explicitly a 'low watermark' with margin relief unproven.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf
